properties.sy_subtitle: Groups: Utility, Editors. Press Run after each ComfyUI update.
properties.sy_install:
This workflow needs only SY Nodes by Stable Yogi.
Two model files make the model nodes work: the Krea 2 Turbo model and the Qwen text encoder (the same two as in the Krea 2 Turbo workflow).
The test picture is the first picture in your ComfyUI input folder.
properties.sy_howto:
1. Press Run.
2. Every SY node runs once. Each one has a Result box next to it.
3. A red node means that node is broken now. Write down its name.
4. Model nodes stay red if the two model files are missing. That is fine.

For a report with no clicking, run sy_master_check.py (see the docs).
properties.sy_info:
Groups follow the node groups: Image, Resize, Editors, Text, Values, Logic, Utility, Notes.
The SOURCES box feeds one picture, one mask and one seed to all nodes.
Wires can be hidden with the link button at the bottom right of the canvas.
